column1: # struct cpuid_feature: size 32, align 4, cpuid_array at 0, active_array at 16 (layouts.tsv);
# both macros have type _Bool (the type probe exits 33 for _Bool and _Bool; this run: 33). index: argument of __x86_get_cpuid_feature_leaf;
# reg/bit: the register word and bit of the CPUID result, the same in cpuid_array and active_array; active=never: the
# macro CPU_FEATURE_ACTIVE is false for every structure; leaf_check: cpuid-match = the words of the real function for that
# index equal the CPUID instruction at leaf/subleaf on the probe host, sdm-only = those words are zero there.
